items.forkReproduction: Present in fork: the finish-length handler in web-app/src/routes/threads/$threadId.tsx treats a missing ctx_len as 32768, and handleContextSizeIncrease on non-llamacpp providers raises a ctx_len nothing sends and calls stopModel, which is a no-op for remote endpoints.
items.decisionReason: Real defect for custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints, but the PR adds a parallel model-context-size module while the fork already learns windows from refusals (contextLimitRecovery, AH-195). Needs a redesign on the fork architecture rather than a port.
items.notes: Half done: the finish-length check no longer assumes 32768 for an unknown window; it uses knownContextWindow (setting, learned refusal limit, provider metadata, bundled table) and treats unknown as not a context verdict (web-app/src/lib/knownContextWindow.ts, 9 tests). Still open: an Increase Context Size action that is honest for providers whose window Jan cannot change.
